notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I've fixed the bug that has you skipping day three if you choose to read junkmail on day three's morning. I've still been unable to recreate the issue with day four repeating, so if you encounter this bug it would be a huge help if you could comment details on what options you selected immediately preceding the issue to help me track it down!

For bugs, grammatical errors, or any other issues, please contact me at nikutreat@gmail.com or through twitter @nikutreat and I'll get them fixed asap!

Thanks,
Nick

notes.title: A Sun of Salt Releases!
notes.notes:
[b]As of 8/27/18, 12pm EST[/b], A Sun of Salt will finally be released on [b]Windows, Linux, and Mac OS![/b]

It's been a long road, and for all the backers that were patient and supportive, you have my deepest gratitude. 

For everyone else, I hope you can find something to enjoy in A Sun of Salt!

-NikuTreat
